c.t:
Short axis < 15 mm, or
benign texture features

Clinical consultation and/or
PET/CT and/or chest CT in 3–6 mo

note: Short-axis measurement is the standard; consider further action if there are many small nodes. * E.g. emphysema, interstitial lung disease, sarcoidosis, cardiac disease. † Consider lymphoma, undiagnosed metastatic disease (including testicular cancer in young men), and infection.
cite: Munden RF et al. Managing Incidental Findings on Thoracic CT: Mediastinal and Cardiovascular Findings. A White Paper of the ACR Incidental Findings Committee. J Am Coll Radiol. 2018;15(8):1087-1096.
